prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: rear-end collision. Injury: back strain. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1453; do not mention it.)
text:
Our office represents [CLIENT_NAME] in connection with the rear-end collision that occurred on [LOSS_DATE]. Our client was stopped at a traffic signal when the insured vehicle struck the rear of their car at a speed sufficient to cause significant impact. The police report documents the point of impact and the resulting damage, and the at-fault driver acknowledged at the scene that they had not noticed the stopped traffic in time.

As a direct result of the collision, our client sustained a lumbar back strain. Symptoms began within hours and have included persistent pain, muscle spasms, and limited mobility. Our client sought prompt medical evaluation, followed a prescribed course of physical therapy, and has been unable to perform certain work duties and household tasks without discomfort. Treatment records and the treating physician's notes are enclosed and confirm the diagnosis and its link to the accident.

Liability in this matter is clear. Your insured failed to maintain a safe following distance and failed to keep a proper lookout, and the resulting harm is well documented. We therefore ask that you resolve this claim by paying the sum of [DEMAND_AMOUNT] within thirty days of the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we will proceed with filing a civil action without further notice.
